user.title: Use this Home Assistant home
user.description: Heatprint reuses the Home Assistant home and its areas — it does not ask you to recreate them. Site {name} at ({latitude}, {longitude}), time zone {timezone}, country {country}. Weather: {weather}. Heat generators already in HA: {generators}. Heated rooms from HA areas: {rooms}. Skipped (no heating circuit or no climate/demand): {skipped}. A failed weather check (shown as an error below) does not block setup; Heatprint retries and opens a repair. Confirm to create the site and sync those rooms. Reconfigure is the escape hatch for a second home or a different weather station; add or edit generators and rooms later if needed.

weather_nl.title: Weather source (Netherlands)
weather_nl.description: Nearest KNMI station: {nearest}. KNMI daily values (mean temperature, wind, radiation) are free, definitive after one or two days and go back decades, which makes long backfills and a climatology possible.

data_description.provider: KNMI is the reference for the Dutch degree-day methods. Open-Meteo is a worldwide reanalysis; your own sensors only work while their long-term statistics exist.
data_description.station_id: Pick the station with the climate that resembles yours most; distance is a good first guess, coast versus inland matters too.
data_description.fallback: Used when the primary source is unavailable, so a day is never lost.

weather_intl.title: Weather source
weather_intl.description: Outside the Netherlands Open-Meteo provides daily reanalysis data worldwide (since 1940) plus the last days from the forecast model.

data_description.provider: Open-Meteo needs no account and supports backfill and climatology. Your own sensors only cover the period for which Home Assistant has long-term statistics.

weather_sensors.title: Weather sensors
weather_sensors.description: Choose sensors with state class measurement; Heatprint reads their daily means from the long-term statistics. Without wind and radiation the methods fall back to temperature only.

data_description.temperature: Required. The daily mean of this sensor becomes the outdoor temperature of the day.
data_description.wind: Optional. Wind increases the heat loss of a house; the effective temperature methods use it.
data_description.radiation: Optional. Solar gain lowers the heat demand; used by the PBL optimal model and the house fit.

reconfigure.title: Location and weather source
reconfigure.description: First setup used this Home Assistant installation. Change the location, time zone or country here if this site is not the HA home; the weather source follows in the next step.

data_description.location: Used for the nearest station or the Open-Meteo grid point.
data_description.timezone: Day boundaries of the meters and the weather.
data_description.country: The Netherlands uses KNMI by default; elsewhere Open-Meteo.

reconfigure_confirm.title: Rebuild history?
reconfigure_confirm.description: The weather source changed. Heatprint will fetch the weather history again and recompute every day record. Existing statistics are overwritten day by day; this can take a while.

error.cannot_connect: The weather provider could not be reached.

user.description: Every generator turns an energy carrier into heat. Space heating stays one line across all generators.

data_description.kind: Determines which sensors and conversion are asked next.
data_description.role: Space heating only, hot water only, or both.

data_description.conversion_mode: Without a thermal meter the heat is an estimate; Heatprint labels it as estimated.
data_description.scop: Used to estimate heat from electricity when no thermal meter exists.
data_description.cop: Average coefficient of performance while heating.
data_description.factor: kWh of heat per unit of the meter.

dhw.description: Splitting off the weather-independent part keeps the heating line honest.

data_description.dhw_mode: Baseline from the summer window, measured with a separate meter, a fixed daily amount, or none.
data_description.dhw_fixed_per_day: In the unit of the meter per day; only with the fixed method.

user.title: Energy-saving measure
user.description: A measure marks a date. Heatprint compares the season before with the period after it. The effect is only meaningful once at least 30 days after the date exist; use the action Measure effect.

data_description.name: For example Triple glazing, Flow temperature 45 °C or Hybrid heat pump.
data_description.date: The first day the measure was in effect.
data_description.category: Insulation mainly changes the slope (heat loss per K), installation the efficiency, behaviour the balance temperature. Used for the interpretation text.
data_description.notes: Free text, for your own reference.

reconfigure.title: Change measure
reconfigure.description: Adjust the measure; the comparison uses the new date the next time you run the action Measure effect.

data_description.name: For example Triple glazing.
data_description.date: The first day the measure was in effect.
data_description.category: Steers the interpretation text (slope versus balance temperature).

error.invalid_name: The name must contain at least one letter or digit.

user.title: Room
user.description: Usually unnecessary: Heatprint already syncs heated HA areas (climate + heating-power sensor) as rooms. Add a room only for a space that was skipped or needs a custom demand entity. Apparent heat loss is an allocation-based estimate, not a design calculation (METHODS §12).

data_description.area_id: Optional. Prefills the name from the area.
data_description.name: For example Living room. The id derived from it is used in statistics and entities.
data_description.demand_entity: Heating-power percentage, valve position, on/off climate, or a dedicated energy meter.
data_description.demand_kind: How the demand entity is interpreted. Metered energy bypasses allocation and is the room's heat directly.
data_description.temperature_entity: Optional. Used for the indicative UA estimate.
data_description.emitter_kind: Used only for the default Watts-per-m² weight when rated output is missing.
data_description.rated_output_w: Preferred weight. Leave empty to use floor area × default W/m².
data_description.floor_area_m2: Enables specific heat loss (W/(m²·K)) and heat per m².
data_description.volume_m3: Captured for later use; not used in the current calculations.
data_description.enabled: Disabled rooms keep their history but are skipped in daily allocation.
data_description.price_entity: Optional override for a metered-energy room. Site cost sensors are not written yet (METHODS §13).

reconfigure.title: Change room
reconfigure.description: The id in statistics and entities does not change when you rename. Disabled rooms keep their history.

methods.title: Methods and season
methods.description: All methods are always computed; enabled decides which get sensors, primary drives the main sensors and the forecast.

data_description.season_start: 1 October is the gas year; 1 January a calendar year; 1 July for the southern hemisphere.
data_description.enabled: Classic is comparable with mindergas, KNMI 14 °C with national gas-year statistics, PBL is the revised national weather correction, house is fitted to your own home.
data_description.primary: Must be one of the enabled methods. House falls back to PBL until a fit exists.
data_description.classic_weighted: Monthly factors of mindergas (Nov-Feb 1.1, Mar and Oct 1.0, Apr-Sep 0.8).

data_description.classic_base_temp: 18 °C is a convention, not a physical constant; the house fit finds your own balance temperature.
data_description.classic_heating_limit: Days with a mean temperature above this limit count zero degree days.
data_description.pbl_parameter_set: Practical (temperature and wind) or optimal (six stations with solar radiation).
data_description.pbl_wind_mode: Linear (wind divided by 1.5) or square root of the wind speed.
data_description.pbl_include_sun: Only sensible when radiation data is available.
data_description.house_fit_wind: Estimate the wind sensitivity of your house from the data.

dhw.title: Hot water and cooking
dhw.description: Per generator: {summary}. The summer window defines the weather-independent baseline.

data.dhw_override: Override split method for all generators

data_description.dhw_override: Keep the per-generator settings, or apply one method to every generator with role both.
data_description.summer_start: Pick a window with no heating at all, normally 06-01.

import_readings.title: Import meter readings
import_readings.description: Paste a CSV or choose a file under /config. Columns, delimiter, decimal and date format are detected automatically. A mindergas.nl export (datum;stand) needs no extra questions.

data_description.csv: Paste the export here. Leave empty when you upload a file or give a path.
data_description.path: Relative to the Home Assistant config folder, for example heatprint/mindergas.csv.
data_description.file: Optional upload. A pasted CSV is used when both are given.
data_description.generator_id: The heat generator these cumulative readings belong to.
data_description.unit: How the numbers in the file are interpreted. Defaults to the generator's carrier unit.

import_columns.title: Choose columns
import_columns.description: The headers ({headers}) were not recognised automatically. Choose which column is the date and which is the meter reading. You never type a JSON mapping.

import_preview.title: Preview import
import_preview.description: {count} readings for {generator} ({unit}). Detected date column {date_column}, reading column {reading_column}, delimiter {delimiter}, decimal {decimal}. First rows: {preview}. Confirm to import and recompute from the earliest day.

import_done.title: Import finished
import_done.description: Imported {imported_days} days ({first_day} – {last_day}). Gaps: {gaps}. Recompute from the first imported day is running in the background.

history.title: History
history.description: Change the backfill and climatology years, or recompute all day records from a date (for example after changing a sensor or importing readings).

data_description.backfill_years: How far back weather and day records are built.
data_description.climatology_years: Years of weather used for the normal season.
data_description.recompute_from: Runs the full pipeline from this date to yesterday in the background after saving.

pricing.title: Prices and CO2
pricing.description: Default emission factors; a live CO2 sensor (kg per kWh) overrides the electricity factor per day.

data_description.gas_co2_factor: kg CO2 per m³ of natural gas; 1.78 is the Dutch default.
data_description.electric_co2_factor: kg CO2 per kWh of electricity; 0.30 is a Dutch average.
data_description.district_co2_factor: kg CO2 per kWh of district heat; depends on the network, ask your supplier.
data_description.co2_entity: Optional sensor with the current grid intensity in kg per kWh.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Bridge to mindergas.nl. Token currently {token_state}. The token is stored in the config entry, never logged and redacted from diagnostics. Leave the field empty to keep the stored token.

data_description.mindergas_token: Personal API token from your mindergas.nl account settings.
data_description.mindergas_generator_id: The gas meter whose reading is sent.
data_description.mindergas_daily_push: After the daily run the meter reading at midnight is sent as today's reading.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Heatprint reuses Home Assistant areas as rooms (climate + heating-demand sensor). Default emitter output per m² is a labelled placeholder (METHODS §12.2). Rooms using it are flagged as estimated. Turning allocation off still computes site heat, but skips the per-room breakdown.

data.auto_sync: Automatically sync rooms from HA areas
data.sync_now: Sync rooms from HA areas now
data.min_room_fit_days: Minimum usable days for a room fit

data_description.allocation_enabled: When off, heat_space_kwh is unchanged and no room statistics are written.
data_description.auto_sync: On setup and reload, create or update room subentries from heated HA areas. Does not duplicate or wipe rated output, emitter kind or floor area you already set.
data_description.exclude_area_ids: Areas that should never become rooms (empty, outdoor, or a zone with no heating circuit).
data_description.sync_now: Run the same sync once after saving, even if automatic sync is off.
data_description.min_room_fit_days: Below this number the room heat-loss coefficient stays unavailable (ROOM_NOT_FITTED).
data_description.output_w_per_m2_radiator: Used when a radiator room has floor area but no rated output. Placeholder, not a design value.
data_description.output_w_per_m2_underfloor: Used when an underfloor room has floor area but no rated output. Placeholder, not a design value.
data_description.output_w_per_m2_electric: Used when an electric room has floor area but no rated output. Placeholder, not a design value.
data_description.output_w_per_m2_other: Used when another emitter has floor area but no rated output. Placeholder, not a design value.

sync_rooms.title: Sync rooms from HA areas
sync_rooms.description: Heatprint will create or update room subentries from heated Home Assistant areas. Included: {rooms}. Skipped: {skipped}. Existing rated output, emitter kind and floor area are kept. Confirm to sync and refresh the rooms dashboard.

sync_rooms_done.title: Rooms synced
sync_rooms_done.description: {summary}. The rooms dashboard was refreshed. Entity cards resolve by unique_id, so a Dutch UI keeps working.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Override the national PBL parameters and the fit settings. Leave the defaults unless you know why.

pbl.name: PBL parameters
pbl.description: Monthly parameters of the PBL 2022 practical model (TST = threshold temperature, RER = slope factor, TOP = temperature independent part).

data_description.pbl_top: Not used in the degree days by default; hot water and cooking are handled separately.
data_description.pbl_wind_sqrt_coef: c_sqrt in T − c_sqrt · √W (PBL 2022 eq. 17/20). Default 1.0 for daily KEV-SJV.

data.min_fit_days: Minimum usable days for a fit

data_description.outlier_threshold: Days with a residual larger than this many times the RMSE are excluded and the fit is repeated once.
data_description.min_fit_days: Below this number of usable days the house method falls back to PBL.

options.auto: Automatic (measured when a thermal meter exists)

options.sqrt: Square root of the wind speed

import_readings.name: Import meter readings
import_readings.description: Power-user action. Prefer Configure → Import meter readings. Imports cumulative meter readings from CSV (for example a mindergas.nl export) and recomputes from the first imported day.

generator_id.name: Generator id
generator_id.description: Id of the generator the readings belong to (for example boiler).

csv.name: CSV text
csv.description: The CSV content; either this or a path.

path.name: File path
path.description: File inside the heatprint folder of your configuration directory.

mapping.name: Column mapping
mapping.description: Column names, date format, decimal sign and delimiter (defaults match the mindergas.nl export).

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Unit of the readings; defaults to the unit of the generator.

recompute.name: Recompute
recompute.description: Recomputes all day records from a date to yesterday and rewrites the statistics.

fit_signature.name: Fit energy signature
fit_signature.description: Fits the energy signature (balance temperature, heat loss per K, wind sensitivity) for a period and returns the fit.

start.name: Start
start.description: First day of the period (or use season).

season.name: Season
season.description: Season label such as 2024/2025 instead of start and end.

tac_preset.name: Effective temperature preset
tac_preset.description: Which effective temperature is used as regressor.

fit_wind.name: Fit wind
fit_wind.description: Estimate the wind sensitivity; defaults to the site setting.

compare_periods.name: Compare periods
compare_periods.description: Compares the weather-corrected heat demand of two periods and returns the comparison.

base_start.name: Base start
base_start.description: First day of the base period.

base_end.name: Base end
base_end.description: Last day of the base period.

target_start.name: Target start
target_start.description: First day of the target period.

target_end.name: Target end
target_end.description: Last day of the target period.

method.name: Method
method.description: Energy signature (normalised consumption with confidence interval) or a degree-day method (k-value comparison).

measure_effect.name: Measure effect
measure_effect.description: Compares the season before an energy-saving measure with the period after it and returns the effect.

measure_id.name: Measure id
measure_id.description: Id of the measure (slug of its name).

forecast.name: Forecast
forecast.description: Returns the forecast of the running season based on the climatology.

export_daily.name: Export day records
export_daily.description: Writes the day records of a period as CSV into the heatprint folder of your configuration directory.

path.name: File name
path.description: File name inside the heatprint folder; a default name is used when empty.

push_reading.name: Push meter reading
push_reading.description: Sends the meter reading at the start of a day to mindergas.nl (token from the options).

generator_id.name: Generator id
generator_id.description: Generator whose meter reading is sent.

date.name: Date
date.description: Date of the reading (reading at midnight at the start of this day); defaults to today.

fit_room_signature.name: Fit room energy signature
fit_room_signature.description: Fits the apparent heat-loss coefficient and balance temperature of one room and returns the fit. Reuses the site TAC; wind is not fitted.

room_id.name: Room id
room_id.description: Id of the room (slug of its name).

start.name: Start
start.description: First day of the period (or use season).

season.name: Season
season.description: Season label such as 2024/2025 instead of start and end.

create_dashboard.name: Create Heatprint dashboard
create_dashboard.description: Creates or recreates the Heatprint overview and Rooms Lovelace dashboards in the sidebar (stock cards only; no custom apexcharts card). Entity cards resolve entity_id from the registry by unique_id, so a Dutch UI works.

clear_statistics.name: Clear statistics
clear_statistics.description: Deletes Heatprint long-term statistics of one generator or of the whole site (including room demand and room temperature means). Use this after removing a generator if you also want the history gone.

generator_id.name: Generator id
generator_id.description: Optional. When set, only the space-heating and DHW statistics of this generator are deleted. When empty, every Heatprint statistic of the site is deleted, including room demand and room temperature means.

csv_invalid.message: The CSV could not be parsed: {error}.

invalid_period.message: The period is invalid: start must be before end.

period_required.message: Give either start and end or a season.

weather_check_failed.title: Weather source not reachable yet
weather_check_failed.description: The first-run weather check for {site} failed ({error}) using {weather}. Heatprint was still created and will keep retrying. Use Reconfigure to pick another station or provider if this persists.
